details: CPS confirms CTCSS values are stored as decimal tenths in the little-endian TX/RX tone words: 103.5 = 0x040B (bytes 0B 04), 206.5 = 0x0811 (bytes 11 08). The normal 32-byte channel record map matches NewChirp. A raw radio image is still required to determine why channels 52-54 decode as no tone.
